opening.text: Jessica Chen, the sharp and ambitious TV journalist, greets you in the green room before the interview.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: jessica
segments.text: Senator, thanks for coming on the show. My viewers want to know where you stand on the Education Reform Bill. Are you ready for some tough questions?

choices.text: "I appreciate the opportunity to speak directly to voters."
"Just give me the easy questions, okay?"

segments.speaker: jessica
segments.text: She grins. "That's what I like to hear. No softballs today, Senator. My audience wants real answers."

segments.speaker: jessica
segments.text: "Let's head to the set. Remember, no dodging the tough questions." She gives you a challenging look as you walk toward the cameras.

consequences.high_respect: Jessica will be fair but tough in future coverage
consequences.high_attraction: Jessica may seek exclusive interviews (complicated dynamic)
consequences.low_reputation: Jessica may be more aggressive in future coverage
